codeReview.summary: The feature is close, but core stack-model matching logic is incorrect for quant/source-specific stack selections. This causes false active indicators and can hide remote-only stack models when a different quant of the same model is present locally.

issues.description: scan_local_models marks a local model active when catalog_entry.id == model_id, even if the stack points to a different source/quant. Example: local has qwen3.5-8b-8bit, stack uses qwen3.5-8b int4 source qwen3.5-8b-4bit; current logic marks the int8 directory active. This violates the requirement that active stack models be accurately indicated.

get_remote_stack_models treats any local model with the same catalog name as 'local' for a stack model ID, regardless of whether the stack's selected source/quant exists locally. In the same int8-local/int4-stack scenario, remote_models becomes empty, so the required remote-only stack row (with remote source and estimated size) is not shown.

_match_to_catalog requires exact equality with repo basename and does not normalize common directory forms like 'mlx-community--<repo>'. This can prevent human-readable catalog names from showing for locally downloaded models that use org-prefixed directory names.
